title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Lambda on Variance
text: As lambda (λ) increases, the regularization term becomes more significant, which can reduce the variance of the model.

title: Lambda and Observational Variance
text: Consider what happens to the variance of the model's predictions as lambda decreases. Does it tend to zero?

title: Analyzing the Statement
text: Evaluate the statement: As lambda decreases, observational variance tends to $$0$$. Is this true or false?
